# SEO data in Sanity

Sanity holds every page's meta tags and JSON-LD facts. Site code maps those fields to HTML and holds no copy or business facts.

## How to change something

1. Put the complete `seo` object for each document in a JSON file: `{"servicePage-local-seo": {...}}`.
2. `npm run seo:write -- file.json` checks the whole site and lists what would change. It writes nothing.
3. `npm run seo:write -- file.json --yes` writes it. It needs `SANITY_AUTH_TOKEN` and stops if someone edited the document meanwhile.
4. Redeploy. Pages rendered per request (`/services`, `/integrations`, `/tools`, `/faqs`, `/contact`, `/blog`) update without one.

`npm run seo:check` checks what is live. It also runs before every build, so bad data stops a deploy. Sanity itself does not enforce these rules on other edits. If bad data reaches a page rendered per request, that page drops its JSON-LD and logs the problem.

**New pages:** publish, then `npm run seo:write`, then deploy. A published page with no `seo` stops every deploy until it has one.

**Drafts:** publishing a draft or release made before an SEO write replaces the document and drops its `seo`. The write command lists the ones it finds.

**Retired fields:** `metaTitle`, `description`, `seoDescription` and `siteTitle` no longer set meta tags. `description` is still the visible intro. Dates shown on a page (`dateModified`, `lastUpdated`) must match `seo.dateModified`.

Every list item needs a unique `_key` and JSON-LD items need a `_type`.

## Page: `seo`

| Field | Type | Rules | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title` | string | required; 10 to 80 characters | The full browser-tab and search-result title, used exactly as written. Name the page and who it is for. Must be unique across the site. Search engines may shorten titles over about 60 characters. Example: `Local SEO for Maryland Businesses | Maryland Insights` |
| `description` | text | required; 50 to 160 characters | The search-result summary. One or two plain sentences saying what the page offers. This is not the visible intro on the page. Must be unique across the site. Example: `Google Business Profile, listings and review work that helps Maryland businesses get found, county by county.` |
| `canonical` | url | optional | Leave empty. Fill only when this page duplicates another URL that should rank instead. |
| `noindex` | boolean | optional | Turn on to keep the page out of search engines and the sitemap. Leave off for normal pages. |
| `ogTitle` | string | optional; 10 to 90 characters | Title on shared links. Leave empty to use the title. |
| `ogDescription` | text | optional; 30 to 200 characters | Summary on shared links. Leave empty to use the description. |
| `ogImage` | path | optional | Share image: a site path or https URL, 1200x630. Leave empty to use the generated image. Example: `/images/share/local-seo.png` |
| `dateModified` | date | optional | The day the page's content last changed in a way a reader would notice. Sets the sitemap date. Leave empty if you do not know. Never set a future date. Example: `2026-10-14` |
| `jsonLd` | list | required; 1 to 10 items | The structured data for this page. Add one item per thing the page describes. Every page needs exactly one schemaWebPage. |

## JSON-LD items: `seo.jsonLd[]`

Every page needs `schemaWebPage`. Required items cannot be switched off. Also required: servicePage: schemaBreadcrumb, schemaService; featurePage: schemaBreadcrumb, schemaService; blogPost: schemaBreadcrumb, schemaArticle.

### `schemaWebPage`

Says what kind of page this is. Title, description and dates come from the fields above.

| Field | Type | Rules | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | boolean | required | On publishes this item. Off keeps it saved but hidden. |
| `pageType` | string | required; one of: WebPage, AboutPage, ContactPage, CollectionPage, ItemPage | WebPage for most pages, AboutPage, ContactPage, CollectionPage for lists (blog, services, tools), ItemPage for one item. |

### `schemaBreadcrumb`

The trail from the homepage to this page. The last item is this page.

| Field | Type | Rules | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | boolean | required | On publishes this item. Off keeps it saved but hidden. |
| `items` | list | required; 2 to 6 items | In order, homepage first. Every path must be a real page. |
| `items[].name` | string | required; up to 110 characters | Label. Example: `Services` |
| `items[].path` | path | required | Site path starting with /. Example: `/services` |

### `schemaService`

A service this page sells. The provider is always the organization in site settings.

| Field | Type | Rules | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | boolean | required | On publishes this item. Off keeps it saved but hidden. |
| `name` | string | required; 3 to 110 characters | Service name as shown on the page. Example: `Local SEO` |
| `description` | text | required; 50 to 500 characters | What the service includes. Must match what the page says. |
| `serviceType` | string | required; 3 to 80 characters | Plain category. Example: `Local search engine optimization` |
| `areaServed` | list | optional; up to 30 items | Places served. Only list places the page or business really covers. |
| `areaServed[].type` | string | required; one of: State, AdministrativeArea, City | State, AdministrativeArea (a county) or City. |
| `areaServed[].name` | string | required | Place name. Example: `Maryland` |

### `schemaArticle`

A blog post. The publish date comes from the post's own date; the modified date from dateModified.

| Field | Type | Rules | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | boolean | required | On publishes this item. Off keeps it saved but hidden. |
| `headline` | string | required; 10 to 110 characters | The post's headline as shown. |
| `image` | path | required | The post's main image. |
| `authorType` | string | required; one of: Organization, Person | Organization uses the site's organization as author. Person needs authorName. |
| `authorName` | string | optional; up to 80 characters | Required when authorType is Person. Must match the byline on the page. |

### `schemaFaq`

Marks up the questions this page shows. They are read from the page's own FAQ, so there is nothing to type and nothing to drift.

| Field | Type | Rules | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | boolean | required | On publishes this item. Off keeps it saved but hidden. |

### `schemaCustom`

Any other schema.org item, as JSON. Use only when no type above fits. Describe only what visitors can see on the page.

| Field | Type | Rules | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | boolean | required | On publishes this item. Off keeps it saved but hidden. |
| `label` | string | required; 3 to 60 characters | What this is, for other editors. |
| `json` | json | required | One JSON object with an @type and no @context. No reviews or ratings of ourselves. Example: `{"@type":"VideoObject","name":"..."}` |

## Site settings: `siteSettings.seo`

| Field | Type | Rules | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `robotsTxt` | text | required; 20 to 8000 characters | The whole robots.txt file. One 'User-agent: *' group, no Crawl-delay, and a Sitemap line. Cloudflare can add its own rules in front. |
| `notFoundTitle` | string | required; 10 to 80 characters | Title of the 404 page. |
| `notFoundDescription` | text | required; 50 to 160 characters | Description of the 404 page. It is never indexed. |
| `organization` | object | required | Who runs the site. Address and phone come from Business in site settings, social profiles from Social links. |
| `organization.type` | string | required; one of: Organization, LocalBusiness, ProfessionalService | Organization unless customers can visit in person during listed hours. |
| `organization.name` | string | required; 2 to 80 characters | Public name. |
| `organization.legalName` | string | optional; up to 120 characters | Registered legal name. Leave empty if unsure. |
| `organization.description` | text | required; 50 to 300 characters | What the company does and for whom. |
| `organization.logo` | path | required | Logo path or https URL, at least 112x112. |
| `organization.email` | email | optional | Public contact email. |
| `organization.areaServed` | list | optional; up to 30 items | Places served. Only list places the page or business really covers. |
| `organization.areaServed[].type` | string | required; one of: State, AdministrativeArea, City | State, AdministrativeArea (a county) or City. |
| `organization.areaServed[].name` | string | required | Place name. Example: `Maryland` |
| `website` | object | required | The site itself. |
| `website.name` | string | required; 2 to 80 characters | Site name. |
| `website.language` | string | required; one of: en-US | Content language. |

## Adding to it

- **A page in an existing type:** give the document a valid `seo` object. No code.
- **A new document type:** add one line to `ROUTES` in the contract and pass `seoId` to `Base`.
- **A new JSON-LD type:** add it to `JSON_LD_ITEMS`, map it in `graph.mjs` and add a test. For a one-off, use `schemaCustom`.

Document types: home, aboutPage, servicesPage, servicePage, featurePage, integrationsPage, toolsPage, faqsPage, contactPage, blogPage, blogPost, legalPage.
